description: Creates or recovers an ArisPay account and makes a payer agent with a spend mandate in one call (side effects: registers the email, creates the agent and its API key, writes credentials to ~/.payagent/config.json on this machine). Moves no money — it does NOT spend funds. Idempotent: re-running with the same email recovers the existing account and its agents. Select this first, before pay, on a machine that has no ArisPay credentials.

email.description: Email to register the account under. It is also the recovery key — use a real address.

name.description: Human name. Falls back to the email local-part.

name: setup
